q07_file_metadata: JVarkit writes no ##fileformat, ##reference or ##source value: its header output is the input file IRI, the contigs, the FILTER definitions and the samples only (VcfToRdf.java:441-495 at fc2356a3).
q08_header_line_census: JVarkit writes only ##contig (as vcf:Chromosome) and ##FILTER definitions; INFO, FORMAT, fileformat, source and every other meta-information line are absent (VcfToRdf.java:448-469 at fc2356a3), so the per-key line counts cannot be recovered.
